name: Improvised Weapons
description:
Anything can be a weapon in the right hands. Sticks, pots, scissors, lutes, even a severed arm: this skill turns them into real weapons, with swings, sweeps, throws and dirty tricks that work with any improvised weapon in hand.

You can train this skill by using abilities and attacking with improvised weapons.

You start at level 10. To go further, craft a Book of Improvised Weapons once you reach level 44 and study it.
